to: every character and observer that has the NPC (or the character, see `senders`) in view (`xy_emit`); the actor only when the NPC is in its view, which is not sure with a `computer`

fields.name: type
fields.description: The animation. `"exchange"` for the exchange NPC. `"poof"` for the statue in spookytown. `<token>s` (for example `"monstertokens"`) for a token exchange: always the token name plus `s`, also when the NPC has another name.

fields.name: success
fields.description: `1` for a success, `0` for a failure. Only `upgrade` and `compound` send `0`.

senders.what: The end of an `upgrade` timer, at the upgrade NPC. Without a `main` instance, at the character.
The end of a `compound` timer, at the compound NPC.
The end of an `exchange` timer, at the exchange NPC. Not for an item with a quest (`qs`): that one sends `game_response` `<quest>_success`.
The `exchange_buy` handler, at the NPC of the token.
The `destroy` handler with `statue`, within `B.sell_dist` of the statue: every time, not only when the rare roll makes the item level 13 (the emit is after that `if`).
